_units: The H of the mark is 100 units tall in 'mark' and in the lockups. 'mark_small' and 'tile' are drawn on a pixel grid: 32 units are 32 px. Hand kerning is in font units (1000 per em), keyed by the index of the letter it moves; it is used for the wordmark. The endorsement uses Mulish's own GPOS pair kerning (endorsed.font_kern). mark_optical_share moves the square mark files left by that share of the arrow overshoot; the tile has its own 1 px shift in its grid values.
palette_notes: Deep green for the mark and the words; gold only for the star and the bioERGOtech line; warm light for tinted pages and for the reversed artwork, which sits on the deep green. Ink is for running text.
